connectors.name: 12-pin connector (2x6)
connectors.orderNote: Pin numbers 1-12 printed in the table and callouts mark pins 1, 6, 7, 12 on the connector photo; positions follow the printed numbers (row of 1-6, then row of 7-12).

uncertain: Board identity: the image shows only a black 12-pin 2x6 wire-to-board connector with a pin table; no product name or board is visible, so it cannot be confirmed that this is the T906's connector.

Hole mapping inferred from callouts: pins 1 and 7 are at one end and 6 and 12 at the other, with 1-6 and 7-12 taken as the two rows; the photo is small and the callout arrows for 1/7 point close together, so which physical row holds 1-6 is not fully clear.
notes: Only one connector is shown; any other headers on the device are not in this image. Callout box '1' partially overlaps table cell 3; the '3' is still legible.
